column4: One-argument target setter shared by Techno-derived slot242 implementations: clears own dword/byte flags including +0x50C, classifies self and candidate through WhatAmI constants Aircraft=2, Building=6, Infantry=0xF, rejects garrison/captive states, writes [this+0x2B4] with the accepted target and clears +0x3B8/+0x304; clearing with an existing spawn manager calls proven SpawnManagerClass::SetTarget(0), whose bytes write spawn-manager target +0x6C. Direct caller 00443B90 supplies either literal 0 or its own one-stack argument with ecx=this. Vtable/RTTI only locates the shared slot; it is not used as the semantic proof.

Three-argument target/cell resolver: second argument is dispatched through an AbstractType-range jump table (0x11..0x23, cross-checked by proven WhatAmI enumerations); cell/terrain branches call the location virtual, 00565730 and CellClass::GetBuilding, compare the occupant with the first argument and return 1/2; radio branch calls RadioClass::HasAnyLink and the first-link resolver; the default forwards all three original arguments to TechnoClass::slot101. The write branch stores a 12-byte descriptor at own +0xC8 as {CurrentFrame, third argument, 0}. Direct callers 004190B0 and 00737430 pass three stack arguments with ecx=this.
